roles_en: Prime minister of the Republic of Armenia
bio_am: Ծնած է Ախալքալաք՝ 1873-ին։ Բժիշկ եւ Դաշնակցութեան ղեկավար, Հայաստանի Հանրապետութեան վարչապետ (1920), մահացած է 1947-ին։
bio_en: Hamazasp (Hamo) Ohanjanian, party name Mherian, was born in Akhalkalaki in 1873 and, after the Tiflis state gymnasium, studied medicine in Switzerland and Moscow; he belonged to the generation that immediately followed the ARF's founders. In 1898 he formed an ARF Red Cross branch in Telav, was especially prominent in 1905, and in 1908 was among the first arrested in the tsarist persecution, held until the great ARF trial of 1912. Released in 1915 with the volunteer movement, he headed the medical-sanitary section of the Union of Towns at the front. He became prime minister of the Republic of Armenia and resigned in November 1920; married to Rubina, he died in Egypt in summer 1947.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: high. Resignation as PM on 23 Nov 1920 is in #92. Sister Satenik Ohanjanian (#340). Photo caption in #396 'Rubina and Hamo Ohanjanian'.
